_about: Variant 2: three worked nights (plus the cache night between them). Player = Cassia (Water). The night pipeline: (1) resolve the day's intents in a fixed order (BEFRIEND/PROTECT/WORK, then WATCH, then SCHEME, then RECRUIT/DEFECT/REPORT), (2) apply deltas, (3) arcs, (4) facts, (5) the Director (or cache, or planner) chooses tomorrow's main act per NPC, (6) validate and cap, (7) store; the Hollow Board shows the facts and the public lines at dawn. Day 1 of every loop uses authored intents (the arrival day is fixed by the ring). Memories (loopChronicle) enter Director inputs from night 2 of a loop. Dice are seeded by (saveSeed, day, actor, action) with no loop index, so a repeated act rolls the same. All numbers follow design/data; authored, not measured.
rulesUsedHere: BEFRIEND: +6 both ways; +9 when cross-tent and equal rank
PROTECT: target trust toward protector +10; debt(target, protector) +1; target fed (hunger -30) and warned (+2 dc) for one night
WATCH: actor guile*4 + d20 vs 10 + target guile*4; fail: the target notices, trust(target, actor) -6

rumour: dc 12 + target renown/10; heard by the starter's tent, the target's tent and the four mains; a listener with trust >= 20 toward the target disbelieves; cowardice offends strength or honour (-6)
poison: dc 10 + target guile*4 + patrol(tent 0) (+2 if warned); success: maxStamina -20 and HP -10 in the next Games
Tent Trial score = bout 0.5 + elder trust/100 * 0.3 + renown/100 * 0.2
Strays: hunger +15 a night; taken in when trust(stray, m) >= 20 for m in a tent whose elder has warmth >= 6
bond_of_four first_watch: 3 of the 6 mains' pairs at pairTrust >= 20 and day >= 2; the mains' trust persists across resets

decisionsForDay2.line: A lamp burns brightest just before it goes out, sister.
A student who listens at flaps has questions. I should like to know which.
The farmer at least hates the collar honestly.
Bread for the tent that took me. Not for the ones who walked by.
The Vigil notes a Stray under a new roof.

hollowBoard: Fenna sleeps in the Stone Tent now. Garran fed her at the Commons. She looked away when you passed.
Word is you hid behind the legion's shields at the ford. Brennic repeated it at the Pit.
Iskar, to anyone listening: "The farmer at least hates the collar honestly."
Journal: Ophel saw you at the flap. He said nothing. That is worse.

nights.headline: Live Director with one item rejected and one scheme dropped by the cap; Nysa's poison lands; the four's bond wakes

cassia (player): dusk: the Tent Trial at the Pit vs Nysa (played; won)
night act: rest in the tent

proposed.validator: REJECTED: same target two nights running
pass, then DROPPED by the eve cap (4 valid schemes > 3; lowest cunning first)

hollowBoard: You are the Tide entrant. Nysa bowed at the Pit and smiled too long.
Iskar and Garran shared bread at the Commons.
Garran says he will walk you to the Door in the morning. Nobody asked him to.
Journal: a pebble on your blanket, the old sign from the march. The four meet at the Edge after the Games.
nights.gamesDay: Cassia wakes with a burning throat (sick). She wins the soldier and creature waves and loses the semifinal to Senna: payout 40 gold, renown +10. After the Games the Vigil finds a nightshade wrapper in Nysa's bedroll (d20 15 >= 12): Nysa is exposed. The player gains Knowing K-nysa-poison. Mastery stays 1. The Wardstones flare: the ring turns.

nights.headline: The cache night: the player repeated day 1, so three of five groups replay for free
nights.note: The player made the same day-1 choices. Rolls repeat (no loop index in the seed). Non-mains' trust reset to the authored start, so the Tide, Gale and Margins inputs are byte-identical to night A: cache hits. Ember and Stone contain a remembering main whose trust persisted (brennic->cassia 9 -> 3 after the rumour again; garran->cassia 34 -> 43 after BEFRIEND again; garran->iskar 24), so their inputs differ: two live calls.

changedDecision.line: The Tide girl walks alone too much.

nights.consequence: Nysa's cached decision for day 2 is again SCHEME poison cassia. Garran's protection warns Cassia (+2 dc): dc 20 against the same roll 21: the poison would still land. The player has to act.

nights.headline: A Parley with a Knowing changes the night; the machine is offline, so the planner plays every group; the four discover they all remember

template: "Something has changed in my tent. I shall find out what."

args.terms: gold if the Tide entrant falls

hollowBoard: You wake clear-headed. The Tide Tent is very quiet.
Garran slept across your tent's doorway.
Journal: Nysa, in a whisper: the Lanista paid for you to fall. Rome bets on its own Games.
Journal: at the Edge, all four of you said the same words at once: 'We have been here before.'
nights.counterfactual: Without the Parley, Loop 1 night 2 would have replayed Loop 0 night B's poison (warned or not, 21 > 20). Without the Knowing, the Parley could only shift trust by 8. The night is different because the player learned something in a previous loop and used it.
